review.official:
Exusiai is a citizen of
Laterano
and as such, is entitled to the privileges listed in Clauses 1-13 of the Laterano Constitution. She is an employee of
Penguin Logistics
who specializes in covert communication, armed escort, and other undercover activities. We suspect she is a Messenger. While contracted with Penguin Logistics, she serves as a liaison to
Rhodes Island
, assisting us with our operations.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Exusiai showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Exusiai sometimes delivers packages with Originium content, but it has not caused infection to date.

She is different from most Laterano in that she is an unabashed optimist. 
Proficient in various means of entertainment, she's the member of the team who always manages to keep herself upbeat, no matter the situation.
Her generosity ends up being the primary reason why she's broke all the time.

The gun is a unique mid and long-range weapon rumored to be discovered by Laterano, thereby becoming one of its symbols. 
Its killing power isn't exceptional, but it's better suited to the average Laterano citizen's temperament than cold steel, thus becoming the weapon of choice in Laterano. Everyone now carries at least one for personal protection. 
Exusiai may seem laid-back, but her marksmanship ranks among the top at Rhodes Island. On one hand, she lacks the attention span for things other than maintaining and operating her gun. On the other hand, her innate marksmanship talents, including visual tracking and timing, are the envy of all sharpshooters.

While Exusiai goes against what anyone might expect of a Laterano, what's even more unbelievable is that she never endured a difficult childhood thanks to a peculiar hobby, nor did she decide to rebel due to some unfortunate circumstance. 
She loves only happy things and grew up a happy person, simple as that. 
Judging from her background, maybe the Laterano aren't as closed-minded as popularly portrayed...

Even with a halo and wings, people often forget Exusiai is a Laterano. Only when the topic swirls around religion does she react with the piety so characteristic of the Laterano. 
Few places outside Laterano hold such primordial, pristine faith, and because of that, very few notice Exusiai's piety. 
But those who do will realize the same person holds such progressive values and at the same time retains reverence for her faith, without any apparent contradictions. 
Also, only by observing Exusiai from this perspective could one realize that behind her wicked smirk lies a pure soul.

Exusiai is my polar opposite. She seems to get along fine with anyone, but lets very few people close to her. 
—Texas

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hey, leader! Got some work for us?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Leader, how about we throw a party? We can play some hip-hop and eat apple pie. The best life is the party life! No party, no life!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Locked and loaded, ready for action! What's the objective today, Leader?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Some people believe money can buy anything. But, uh-uh, that saying doesn't really apply to me. Wealth won't make a lick of difference to where my targets end up.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My first wish: more guns! We angels all have a patron firearm, a special gun we grow up with, but owning just one gun is kinda lame. I want eight more!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My second wish: get someone to turn off this light over my head!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've always got Texas covered, that's why she lives so carefree. So obvious it goes without saying, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you ever run into an angel with black horns oozing ominous vibes, please tell her for me: I've never forgotten her.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Us Penguin Logistics girls ain't so bad, right? What do you say, leader? Wanna come be our boss? Hehe, just kidding.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh Lord… is this another soul for us to save?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Password: 'Long live the Penguin Empire.' So you're the client? Call me Exusiai. I'm nothing like that Lupo ice queen. I'm always down for some fun!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'm lovin' this feeling!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks for the promotion, leader.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Leader... No, savior, I swear on this gun in my hand, I will protect you until the day of reckoning.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Squad combat? I'm very familiar with that.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You've got a good eye. No one makes a better leader than me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go! Take them all by storm!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Relax, I already called dibs on the most lucrative real estate in Hell, to share with all of you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Is it my turn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Follow me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let me double their trouble.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Divine judgment!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Rock n' roll!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Barrage!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Apple pie!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Perfect! Let's keep up the momentum and charge on!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: May my hail of bullets bring you eternal peace.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Victory is a heavenly melody. Alright, let's go home and grab some beers!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Life is like a gun, sometimes it just jams. Don't get discouraged, leader, we'll get'em next time.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wowee! I love this place!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Leader, wanna try out my weapon?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Leader! The party's about to start, Employee Performance Competition Night's over, and I'm not dead last! Here's your booze and apple pie. Let's heat ourselves up to the hip-hop beat, and set this firework tower to the sky~ Here we go! Three, two—BANG!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Sup, leader!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Leader, c'mere, c'mon! Welcome to your birthday party! Turn out the lights and blow out your candles! Oh, but remember, even as the candles go out, my halo will shine on you in the dark. Never worry that you'll lose your way—the angel's Blessings will be forever at your side.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: We are led in differing directions. But by your power and wisdom, you may guide us on our journey together. Should the soul in you that protects us be a constant, we too will open a brand new path for you by our souls of honesty and ardor.
